mostWorthwhile.text: Following the volatiles from melt into an atmosphere was worthwhile: it showed that outgassing releases existing material rather than creating water’s hydrogen.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to combine the bubbles directly with Earth was unproductive; they had no available operation at that point.

surprise.text: The bubbles initially could not combine with anything, but became usable with upwelling rock after the surface sequence.

arbitrary.text: The initial lack of any bubble operation felt a little opaque; it was not clear why upwelling had to be established first.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the steam-rich atmosphere and fractured crust lead to rain and a shore; the linked physical processes were interesting.
